title: Building Dynamic Data Streams with OpenTelemetry: Smarter Telemetry Routing with a Custom Connector
summary: Why and how we built a custom OpenTelemetry connector and a three-layer pipeline to enable flexible, O(1) telemetry routing with Odigos Data Streams.
